pages.title: A Trick up Your Blade
pages.text: Successfully imbue a compatible weapon with a spell.

pages.title: A Trick up Your Blade
pages.text: Combine spellcraft with equipment you already use.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use the installed Arcane Anvil recipe and a compatible weapon. Take the result with a new usable spell entry; the weapon is never supplied by this reward.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: A compatible blade accepts a spell at the Arcane Anvil. Its consumed scroll is not simply recovered by removing the spell.
